static_traits.name: Sun Danna
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, no immediate family members
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends to discuss Average issues with, but has not yet discussed language-related insecurity with them; tends to avoid Social situations involving less-proficient languages
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received counseling or psychotherapy before; no similar language-related problem history before

basic_info.main_problem: I feel inadequate and a sense of failure in language ability (especially Italian); after making a mistake speaking Italian in a professional setting a few years ago, I keep worrying I will never master the language; pressure mainly comes from Demands for perfect performance in professional settings, gradually leading to decreased self-confidence in speaking Italian and spreading Self-doubt to other languages.
basic_info.core_demands: That Italian expression mistake triggered deeper self-inadequacy and Self-doubt, affecting career and personal life, so hoping to address and ease these issues through counseling.
growth_experiences: Made a mistake using Italian in a professional setting a few years ago under great pressure (needing perfect performance); the event triggered and reinforced inadequacy about one's own ability and catastrophic worries. Since then, strong Anxiety and avoidance appear whenever needing to speak Italian or facing language challenges, Decreased confidence, and began doubting abilities in other languages; Professional performance affected, and more avoidance in social settings from worrying about 'making mistakes'.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent
I will never learn to speak Italian well

special_situations.event: Needs to speak or present in Italian in professional settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot be perfect and make no mistakes, it means I am incompetent / a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding using Italian in public; doubling practice and using language Learning apps
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will fail again, making everyone think I am incompetent

special_situations.event: Reports a translation project in front of colleagues, worrying they will notice any of his mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' evaluations determine my worth; once a mistake is found, it proves I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently seeks comfort and reassurance from others beforehand; excessively checks details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am incompetent

special_situations.event: Recalls that mistake years ago when speaking Italian in a professional setting
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake proves I will never be capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to 'prove oneself' through harder practice, while reducing opportunities to use Italian publicly
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never speak Italian well

special_situations.event: When preparing to present results to the team, focuses only on possible mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Mistakes say more about my ability than strengths do; any small error counts as failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checks and revises, ignoring one's existing strengths and level of completion
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Any small mistake shows I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as professional and capable, having stable self-worth and a sense of being accepted
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being seen as incompetent by others, being negated or humiliated, thus losing career opportunities and self-esteem
defense_goal: Lowers the possibility of being criticized by avoiding high-risk settings and pursuing perfection
Seeking reassurance from others to ease uncertainty and Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A mistake-prone, possibly failing judged person / not-good-enough self
object_relations.object_representation: Others who find fault and judge (colleagues/audience)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to present in Italian in front of colleagues or face evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will think I am incompetent and will pick out my mistakes (transference: Projecting Self-doubt as others' views)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keep a steady, non-judgmental tone, inviting distinction between speculation and evidence; using Socratic Questioning to gently explore the basis of worries and alternative Interpretations.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to view imperfection and mistakes from a more balanced perspective (such as the counselor Guiding cognitive restructuring)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If not perfect it means failure, so one must find 'reasonable causes' for failure (such as age)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a supportive tone, points out the limitations of the age explanation; uses concrete case comparisons to guide her to examine evidence and the possibility of exceptions, reducing self-blame.

manifestations: Tending to avoid Social situations involving less-proficient languages
Although having a few close friends, not yet having discussed language-related insecurity with them

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated Self-doubt and negation ('I am not good enough' 'I will fail')
In professional and social settings, is overly cautious, over-checking and over-revising
Reducing opportunities to use Italian publicly out of fear of making mistakes

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Assuming others will think oneself incompetent when presenting in front of colleagues
Projecting the inner 'failure' self-image as others' negative evaluation
Defines self-worth through others' views (seeking external reassurance)

positive_force: Having a Master's degree in linguistics and a multilingual professional background
Already actively tried practicing and using language Learning apps
Willing to seek psychological counseling, open to change
Has a certain degree of social support (has several close friends)
negative_force: Perfectionist pressure and external-evaluation orientation, excessively dependent on others' recognition
Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mental filtering, mind reading
Avoidance and freeze responses in high-pressure professional settings
Decreased self-esteem and widespread Self-doubt (spreading from Italian to other languages)
Tends to seek assurance rather than build inner self-efficacy

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and avoidance in professional or Social situations requiring Italian
antecedent: Needs to speak or present in Italian in professional settings
Facing language challenges or needing to present translation results
Colleagues present; may be evaluated or have errors pointed out
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing beliefs formed after the mistake years ago (one mistake = never capable), plus an external-validation tendency centered on others' evaluations.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being judged and shame, easing Anxiety short-term
target_behavior.consequence: Professional performance impaired, reduced Learning and practice opportunities, Decreased self-esteem and deepened doubt about other languages

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently Seeking comfort and reassurance from others when language performance is uncertain
antecedent: Worry about mistakes before a presentation or report
Anxiety when needing to use Italian in front of colleagues
target_behavior.core_reason: Unstable self-worth and external-evaluation orientation, trying to counter uncertainty and Fear with others' reassurance.
target_behavior.function: Gaining others' comfort to temporarily lower Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Increased dependence on external recognition, weakened inner Self-efficacy, the problem not yet fundamentally eased
